definitions.explanation: The red liquid that circulates through the body. Also used metaphorically for lineage or temperament.

examples.english: You're bleeding. / Blood is coming out.
I cut my finger and it bled.
I take after my father. (lit. I inherit my father's blood)

examples.japanese: {血|ち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{怖|こわ}く→怖い：00864_kowai⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I get scared when I see blood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{怪我|けが}→けが：00787_kega⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{血|ち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらない→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: I got injured and the bleeding won't stop.

notes:
{血|ち} is the common word for blood; ⟦{血液|けつえき}→血液：02703_ketsueki⟧ is more formal/medical.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {血|ち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to bleed
- {血|ち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}す→流す：01968_nagasu⟧: to shed blood
- {血|ち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{気|け}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to turn pale
- {血|ち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to inherit (bloodline)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{血液|けつえき}→血液：02703_ketsueki⟧: blood (medical/formal)
- ⟦{血液型|けつえきがた}→血液型：03053_ketsuekigata⟧: blood type
- ⟦{献血|けんけつ}→献血：16161_kenketsu⟧: blood donation
- ⟦{出血|しゅっけつ}→出血：11735_shukketsu⟧: bleeding

CULTURAL NOTE: In Japan, blood type (⟦{血液型|けつえきがた}→血液型：03053_ketsuekigata⟧) is popularly believed to indicate personality traits.
